PLAN THE WORK

One point of contact for your bathroom.

A complete bathroom should work as well as it looks. Connor coordinates the plumbing, electrical work, tiling or wet-wall installation, flooring and other finishing trades, so you do not have to arrange each trade separately. The work included is agreed for your room.

Grandison offers supply-and-fit and installation-only bathroom projects. If you plan to supply your own suite, discuss the dimensions, connections and delivery dates before ordering.

Our bathroom fitters serve homes across Fife, including Dunfermline, Kirkcaldy, Glenrothes, Cowdenbeath, Lochgelly and Dalgety Bay. Send your postcode, photographs and what you want to change to start the conversation.

GOOD TO KNOW

Your questions,
answered.

Do you arrange all the trades?

Yes. Connor arranges the plumbing, electrical work, tiling, flooring and other finishing trades for a complete bathroom project. The exact work included is agreed in your quote.

Can you supply the bathroom as well as fit it?

Yes. Grandison offers supply and fit, or installation only if you prefer to supply your own fittings. Check suitability and delivery dates with Connor before buying.

Can I keep the existing layout?

Keeping fittings in similar positions may reduce plumbing alterations. The existing pipework and condition of the room still need to be assessed.

Do you have photographs of your work?

Yes. The project gallery contains real supplied photographs of completed Grandison work.
